resources.string: Say “Tetra”, “OK Tetra”, “Ahoy Tetra” or “Hey Tetra” to open AI Assist, even with the screen off. It compares what the mic hears with your own takes, on the phone; nothing is sent while it listens. With the phone locked, personal things (calls, messages, mail, calendar, notes, files, contacts) ask you to unlock it first. On one device only: two would both answer, so leave it off on the tablet. Paused in the car.
Say each phrase four times as you will to the phone: put it where it usually lies and speak from where you usually are, two takes near and two from further away. Tap a take to record it again.
Unlike the others: record it again
Not caught: nearest “%1$s”, %2$s of its threshold. Record its takes again.
